articles.title: Kraken parent goes for the OCC charter in bid to become a federal crypto bank
articles.snippet: Payward’s application would add a federally regulated trust company to the Kraken group’s existing Wyoming bank charter and Fed master account.

articles.title: Google Found a Way to Make Local AI Up to 3x Faster—No New Hardware Required
articles.snippet: Google's new Multi-Token Prediction drafters can make Gemma 4 run up to 3x faster on your own hardware—no cloud required, and no quality lost.
